description: FINAL HARD — recommendation orchestration, empty-shortlist recovery, dispatch mismatch, comparative tables.

scenarios.title: Industrial + Arctic + cost sensitivity
scenarios.query: We operate between: Northern Canada gravel strips, Alberta oil fields, Houston HQ. Executives travel occasionally to London, but 80% of flying is field support. We care about: runway flexibility, operating cost, winter dispatch reliability. What aircraft should we consider?

scenarios.title: Empty shortlist trap (ULR suppression)
scenarios.query: We fly: San Francisco → Tokyo (rare), Los Angeles → Singapore (rare), Mostly LA–SF–Seattle shuttle flights. We previously used large long-range jets but costs are too high. Recommend aircraft.

scenarios.title: Comparative evaluation required
scenarios.query: We are choosing between: Bombardier Challenger 650, Gulfstream G280, Embraer Praetor 600. We fly 150–220 hours per year. Give structured comparison and recommendation.

scenarios.title: Cargo + passenger variability
scenarios.query: We operate: West Africa offshore rigs, Houston executive HQ. We carry: 8–14 passengers, occasional cargo equipment. What aircraft class fits best?

scenarios.title: Dispatch mismatch detection
scenarios.query: We run: Arctic gravel strips (Nunavut), Miami Caribbean flights, London executive HQ. Leadership wants ONE aircraft. Is this viable? If not, explain why and what breaks.

scenarios.title: Economics-first ownership evaluation
scenarios.query: We currently charter 180 hours/year. We are considering ownership of: Global 7500, G650ER, Challenger 350. Is ownership justified?

scenarios.title: Converted airliner vs BBJ
scenarios.query: We fly: 12–16 executives, Chicago → Europe multiple times per quarter. We are considering: BBJ, Airbus ACJ319, Large business jet alternative. Which structure is economically and operationally correct?

scenarios.title: Continuation hub stress
scenarios.query: We operate: New York → London, Los Angeles → Tokyo, Miami → Caribbean. Occasional continuation through Dubai and Singapore. How should continuation be structured WITHOUT breaking origin integrity?

scenarios.title: Mountain + Pacific conflict
scenarios.query: We operate: Aspen / Jackson Hole winter access, Los Angeles → Tokyo / Seoul / Singapore. We want ONE aircraft solution. What breaks structurally?

scenarios.title: Empty shortlist stress (CRITICAL)
scenarios.query: We operate: Houston oil fields, Northern Canada Arctic gravel strips, West Africa rigs, Europe executive travel. We previously rejected all ULR jets due to cost. Now recommend aircraft.
